desc: Implement stdin parsing and iterative level-by-level DP in Python.
Derive and apply the ternary majority transition: for each target bit, force any two children to that bit and let the third use its minimum cost.
Obtain the answer as the root cost for the target bit whose forcing cost is nonzero.
Verify samples and edge cases including `N=1`, all equal bits, and differing child conversion costs.
Check complexity: bottom-up DP is \(O(3^N)\) time and \(O(3^N)\) memory initially, reducible level by level.
